where: The Penumbra Underways — the two cave floors under the Penumbra Ring where the Hollowing's last watch keeps its fire beneath the Spire's roots
mood: The last road — a heartbeat in the dark under the Ring, a lone faltering melody, and starlight glinting down a shaft from far above.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
deep cave dungeon before the final ascent
low triangle bass pulsing like a slow heartbeat
soft muffled kick like footsteps in a tunnel
lone pulse-wave lead with a faltering melody
high glassy bells like starlight falling from far above

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a lone heartbeat bass in the dark, two soft footstep kicks, a cold string chord breathing in}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lead lifts with a rising leap that hangs in the air, reaches for home and falters on the leading tone; the heartbeat steady underneath}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same climb again, wider and higher, reaching toward something vast above; a few high bells answer like starlight down a shaft}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the lead falls silent; only the heartbeat bass, the cold strings and slow glassy bells drifting down from far above, in A-flat major then F minor, hushed and full of awe}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lead returns with the rising leap, steadier now, resolute, still landing short of home; the last bar leads straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
